_comment_purpose: Smoke test for canabidiol-q1-testable.shy v2 (post-formalism refactor). Validates that sweeping ▢ DISEASE_SEVERITY through the ▢→event→◇→Φ bridge produces endpoint separation in Aβ_Monomer / Aβ_Plaque / NFkB_p65 at 24 h under chronic Abeta_Production forcing.
_comment_accept: PASS if mean(Aβ_Monomer @ 24h | DSEV=2) > 1.5 × mean(Aβ_Monomer @ 24h | DSEV=0). Also expect monotone separation in Aβ_Plaque and NFkB_p65.
_comment_horizon: 24 h — long enough for Abeta_Production to overcome clearance and reach quasi-steady; short enough for fast iteration (~2-3 min wall).
_comment_scope: 2 conditions × 3 replicates = 6 runs. Confirms chronic dose-response is wired before launching the full DSEV grid.
